meta.rule: f = c/λ/2^40 (the forty-octave rule): 350 nm → 779 Hz, 1 µm → 273 Hz, 2.5 µm → 109 Hz; an infrared band is a lower note
meta.bands: [label, centre nm, depth (absorption) or strength in continuum units (emission), FWHM nm, a|e|s]
meta.note: q: 'm' a measured spectrum of the body (s its short source), 'c' its measured colours (n filters; the inner points of c are the filters), 't' typical of its class (cls). w: the measured range, outside it the curve is held flat. r: keys of refs. Curated curves read from the published spectra and rounded (APPROX); measured curves from bodyspec_measured.py
meta.small: small named moons without a measurement of their own point (alias) at class templates x_…: their group's reflectance class from the colours and spectra of its brighter members, marked class-typical (t)

classes.x_jinner: Jupiter's inner moons: dark red like Amalthea (Thomas et al. 1998; Takato et al. 2004)
classes.x_irrC: Jupiter's prograde irregulars (Himalia group, Themisto, Carpo, Valetudo): grey C-type, weak 0.7-µm band (Grav et al. 2003; Jarvis et al. 2000; Bhatt et al. 2017; Brown & Rhoden 2014)
classes.x_irrD: Jupiter's Ananke and Carme groups: reddish, D-like (Grav et al. 2003; Bhatt et al. 2017)
classes.x_irrP: Jupiter's Pasiphae group: mixed, P-like (Grav et al. 2003; Bhatt et al. 2017)
classes.x_ringice: Saturn's ring moons, co-orbitals, Alkyonides and Trojans: icy like the rings, reddened by ring dust (Buratti et al. 2019)
classes.x_irrLR: Saturn's Inuit and Gallic groups: light red (Grav et al. 2003; Grav & Bauer 2007)
classes.x_irrN: Saturn's Norse group: dark grey, near-neutral (Grav & Bauer 2007)
classes.x_uinner: Uranus's inner moons: dark like the rings, weak water ice (Karkoschka 2001)
classes.x_irrR: Uranus's irregulars: red like Sycorax and Caliban (Romon et al. 2001; Grav et al. 2004)
classes.x_ninner: Neptune's inner moons: dark like Proteus (Karkoschka 2003)
classes.x_pice: Styx, Kerberos: water ice like Nix and Hydra (Weaver et al. 2016)
